सरदार पटेल विश्वविद्यालय की अंतर-महाविद्यालय वार्षिक एथलेटिक मीट-2026 का सोमवार को वल्लभ राजकीय महाविद्यालय मंडी में शुभारंभ हुआ। प्रदेश सरकार की उच्च शिक्षा निदेशक सुनीता सिंह ने प्रतियोगिता का विधिवत उद्घाटन किया।
इस एथलेटिक मीट में विश्वविद्यालय से संबद्ध 15 महाविद्यालयों के 160 से अधिक महिला एवं पुरुष खिलाड़ी हिस्सा ले रहे हैं। प्रतियोगिता के दौरान खिलाड़ी विभिन्न एथलेटिक स्पर्धाओं में अपनी प्रतिभा और खेल कौशल का प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं।
प्रतियोगिता के पहले दिन आयोजित मुकाबलों में मेजबान वल्लभ राजकीय महाविद्यालय मंडी के खिलाड़ियों ने शानदार प्रदर्शन किया। पुरुष वर्ग की 1500 मीटर दौड़ में मेजबान कॉलेज के खिलाड़ियों ने पहला और दूसरा स्थान हासिल किया।
इस स्पर्धा में ईशान ठाकुर ने शानदार दौड़ लगाते हुए स्वर्ण पदक अपने नाम किया। मेजबान महाविद्यालय के खिलाड़ियों के प्रदर्शन से कॉलेज परिसर में उत्साह का माहौल रहा।
प्रतियोगिता के शुभारंभ अवसर पर एनसीसी कैडेट्स ने आकर्षक मार्च पास्ट प्रस्तुत किया। अनुशासन और शानदार तालमेल के साथ किए गए मार्च पास्ट ने उपस्थित अतिथियों और दर्शकों का मन मोह लिया।
अंतर-महाविद्यालय एथलेटिक मीट के माध्यम से विभिन्न कॉलेजों के खिलाड़ियों को अपनी खेल प्रतिभा दिखाने और प्रतिस्पर्धा का अवसर मिल रहा है।

An Austrian national sustained injuries after his paraglider fell approximately 500 feet into agricultural fields in the Guma (Chhanang) area of Mandi district on Sunday.
The injured tourist has been identified as Nicholas Thomas. Initial reports suggest the paraglider lost stability mid-air before plummeting to the ground.
Information was available with The Chenab Times that local residents and police personnel responded swiftly to the incident, initiating a rescue operation. Thomas was subsequently transported to Civil Hospital Jogindernagar via an ambulance.
He reportedly sustained injuries to his legs, back, and shoulder and is currently receiving medical treatment. Authorities have stated that the precise circumstances leading to the paragliding accident are still under investigation.
The incident occurred in Mandi district, a popular destination for adventure sports in Himachal Pradesh. Paragliding, along with other activities like trekking and river rafting, attracts a significant number of tourists to the state throughout the year. However, such accidents, though infrequent, highlight the inherent risks associated with adventure tourism and the importance of stringent safety protocols and regular equipment checks.
The Guma area, known for its scenic beauty, is often frequented by paragliding enthusiasts. Reports of such incidents often prompt authorities to review safety regulations and enforcement measures for adventure sports operators. The state government has previously emphasized the need for certified operators and adherence to international safety standards to ensure the well-being of tourists engaging in high-risk activities.
The injured tourist, Nicholas Thomas, is receiving care at Civil Hospital Jogindernagar, where medical professionals are attending to his injuries. The local police have registered a case and are gathering statements from witnesses to determine the cause of the paraglider malfunction or loss of control. Investigations into such incidents typically involve assessing factors such as weather conditions, pilot experience, equipment condition, and operational procedures of the adventure sports provider.
While the exact details of the crash are yet to be officially confirmed, the focus remains on the recovery of the tourist and a thorough investigation into the event. The Himachal Pradesh tourism department is expected to review the findings of the police investigation to implement any necessary corrective actions to prevent future occurrences. The district administration in Mandi has also been involved in coordinating the rescue and medical response, ensuring that the injured tourist receives adequate care.
